Split a Stray Initial Glued to a Surname

Source: R/parse_one_name.R
split_glued_initial.Rd

Defect 3: CWOOLFOLK -> c("C", "WOOLFOLK"). Only splits when the token is a single leading consonant followed by a run that is itself a valid census surname, and the whole token is not a known census name (guards BLAKE, SHAW, WOOD).

Usage

split_glued_initial(tok)

Arguments

tok

A single uppercased name token.

Value

The token unchanged, or a length-2 vector c(initial, surname).
